similar_cases.question: 查询2025年各企业适用的所得税税率及应纳税所得额，按税率从低到高排列
similar_cases.query: SELECT c.company_name, (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) AS taxable, CASE WHEN c.is_key_high_tech THEN 0.15 WHEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE THEN 0.20 ELSE 0.25 END AS rate FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 ORDER BY rate, taxable DESC;

similar_cases.question: 计算2025年度各企业应纳税所得额的同比变化率
similar_cases.query: SELECT c.company_name, ((r2025.taxable - r2024.taxable) / r2024.taxable * 100) AS change_rate FROM (SELECT company_id, revenue - non_taxable_income - deductions - prior_year_losses AS taxable FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns WHERE tax_year = 2025) r2025 JOIN (SELECT company_id, revenue - non_taxable_income - deductions - prior_year_losses AS taxable FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns WHERE tax_year = 2024) r2024 ON r2025.company_id = r2024.company_id JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r2025.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r2024.taxable > 0;

similar_cases.query: SELECT c.company_name, ((r2025.taxable - r2024.taxable) / r2024.taxable * 100) AS change_rate FROM (SELECT company_id, revenue - non_taxable_income - deductions - prior_year_losses AS taxable FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns WHERE tax_year = 2025) r2025 JOIN (SELECT company_id, revenue - non_taxable_income - deductions - prior_year_losses AS taxable FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns WHERE tax_year = 2024) r2024 ON r2025.company_id = r2024.company_id JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r2025.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r2024.taxable > 0;

similar_cases.question: 查询2025年度各公司相对于2024年度的收入增长率，列出公司名称及增长率
similar_cases.query: SELECT c.company_name, (r2025.revenue - r2024.revenue) / r2024.revenue * 100 AS growth_rate FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r2025 JOIN finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r2024 ON r2025.company_id = r2024.company_id AND r2024.tax_year = 2024 JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r2025.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r2025.tax_year = 2025;

similar_cases.question: 查询2025年度收入超过1亿元的企业名称及其收入总额
similar_cases.query: SELECT c.company_name, r.revenue FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 AND r.revenue > 10000;

question: 计算“贵州茅台”在2025年第一季度末的每股净资产

similar_cases.question: 计算各行业2025年平均每股净资产
similar_cases.query: SELECT i.industry_name, AVG((f.total_assets * 10000) / s.total_shares) FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON s.company_id = c.company_id JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id JOIN common.dict_industry i ON c.industry_code = i.industry_code WHERE f.report_date = '2025-12-31' GROUP BY i.industry_name;

similar_cases.question: 请计算贵州茅台2025年度应纳所得税额

question: 计算各股票2025年股价波动幅度比例

knowledge.text: 股价波动幅度比例（价格波动率）计算公式：(年内最高价 - 年内最低价) / 年内均价，年内均价可用收盘价均值近似。反映股价年度波动程度。

similar_cases.question: 查询2025年价格波动率最大的前五只股票
similar_cases.query: SELECT s.stock_name, (MAX(t.close_price) - MIN(t.close_price)) / AVG(t.close_price) AS volatility FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id WHERE t.trade_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY s.stock_name ORDER BY volatility DESC LIMIT 5;

similar_cases.question: 计算每只股票2025年12月31日的市盈率PE
similar_cases.query: SELECT s.stock_name, t.close_price / (((f.total_assets - f.total_liabilities) * 10000) / s.total_shares) AS pe FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id WHERE f.report_date = '2025-12-31' AND t.trade_date = '2025-12-31';

question: 查询市净率最高的前五只股票

similar_cases.question: 查询市净率最低的前十只股票及其市净率
similar_cases.query: SELECT s.stock_name, (t.close_price / ((f.total_assets * 10000) / s.total_shares)) AS pb FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id WHERE f.report_date = '2025-12-31' AND t.trade_date = '2025-12-31' ORDER BY pb LIMIT 10;

similar_cases.question: 计算2025年市净率低于1的股票数量和平均市净率
similar_cases.query: SELECT COUNT(*), AVG(pb) FROM (SELECT t.close_price / ((f.total_assets * 10000) / s.total_shares) AS pb FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id WHERE f.report_date = '2025-12-31' AND t.trade_date = '2025-12-31') sub WHERE pb < 1;

question: 计算2025年所有企业平均应纳税所得额

knowledge.text: 企业所得税额计算公式：应纳税所得额 × 适用税率，单位：万元。
应纳税所得额计算公式：revenue - non_taxable_income - deductions - prior_year_losses，单位：万元。
一般企业所得税税率为25%。

similar_cases.question: 查询国有企业2025年平均应纳税所得额
similar_cases.query: SELECT AVG(r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id JOIN common.dict_registration_type rt ON c.registration_type_code = rt.type_code WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 AND rt.type_name = '国有独资公司';

similar_cases.question: 查询2025年各企业适用的所得税税率及应纳税所得额，按税率从低到高排列
similar_cases.query: SELECT c.company_name, (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) AS taxable, CASE WHEN c.is_key_high_tech THEN 0.15 WHEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE THEN 0.20 ELSE 0.25 END AS rate FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 ORDER BY rate, taxable DESC;

企业所得税额计算公式：应纳税所得额 × 适用税率，单位：万元。

question: 请计算中国中车2025年度实际税负率

knowledge.text: 实际税负率计算公式：(应纳税额 / 收入总额) × 100%。其中应纳税额 = 应纳税所得额 × 适用税率，单位：%。

similar_cases.question: 请计算中国中车2025年每万元资产的所得税贡献额（元）
similar_cases.query: SELECT ((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * 0.25) / r.total_assets * 10000 AS tax_per_wan_yuan_asset FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.stocks s ON r.company_id = s.company_id WHERE s.stock_name = '中国中车' AND r.tax_year = 2025;

similar_cases.question: 计算各企业2025年度的实际税负率，列出实际税负率低于15%的企业
similar_cases.query: SELECT c.company_name, ((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * CASE WHEN c.is_key_high_tech THEN 0.15 WHEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE THEN 0.20 ELSE 0.25 END / r.revenue) * 100 AS effective_rate FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 HAVING effective_rate < 15;

similar_cases.question: 计算小型微利企业相对于25%税率节省的税额

similar_cases.question: 比较不同企业注册类型的平均企业所得税税额
similar_cases.query: SELECT rt.type_name, AVG((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * CASE WHEN c.is_key_high_tech THEN 0.15 WHEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE THEN 0.20 ELSE 0.25 END) AS avg_tax FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id JOIN common.dict_registration_type rt ON c.registration_type_code = rt.type_code WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 GROUP BY rt.type_name ORDER BY avg_tax DESC;

similar_cases.question: 比较各行业小型微利企业与高新技术企业的所得税优惠总额
similar_cases.query: SELECT i.industry_name, SUM(CASE WHEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE AND c.is_key_high_tech = FALSE THEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * 0.05 WHEN c.is_key_high_tech THEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * 0.10 ELSE 0 END) AS tax_benefit FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id JOIN common.dict_industry i ON c.industry_code = i.industry_code WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 GROUP BY i.industry_name;

question: 计算所有股票2025年的年化波动率

knowledge.text: 年化波动率计算公式：日涨跌幅的标准差 × SQRT(250)，其中日涨跌幅 = (close_price - open_price) / open_price。250为年交易日数近似值。单位：%。
股价波动幅度比例（价格波动率）计算公式：(年内最高价 - 年内最低价) / 年内均价，年内均价可用收盘价均值近似。反映股价年度波动程度。

similar_cases.question: 查询2025年价格波动率最大的前五只股票
similar_cases.query: SELECT s.stock_name, (MAX(t.close_price) - MIN(t.close_price)) / AVG(t.close_price) AS volatility FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id WHERE t.trade_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY s.stock_name ORDER BY volatility DESC LIMIT 5;

similar_cases.question: 计算2025年各股票的日均成交金额
similar_cases.query: SELECT s.stock_name, (SUM(t.volume * t.close_price) / COUNT(t.trade_id)) AS avg_daily_value FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id WHERE t.trade_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY s.stock_name ORDER BY avg_daily_value DESC;

question: 查询各发电场站中装机容量超过所属企业平均装机容量的场站名称

knowledge.text: 装机容量单位MW（兆瓦），年发电量单位万kWh。大型火电厂装机容量≥3000MW，大型水电站装机容量≥1000MW，大型风电场装机容量≥500MW，大型光伏电站装机容量≥200MW。
小型发电场站判断标准：装机容量低于100MW。

similar_cases.question: 查询各发电场站中装机容量超过同类型平均装机容量的场站名称
similar_cases.query: SELECT es.station_name, es.installed_capacity, et.type_name FROM energy.energy_station es JOIN common.energy_type_dict et ON es.energy_type_code = et.type_code WHERE es.installed_capacity > (SELECT AVG(es2.installed_capacity) FROM energy.energy_station es2 WHERE es2.energy_type_code = es.energy_type_code);

similar_cases.question: 查询各电力企业中总装机容量最大的发电场站名称
similar_cases.query: SELECT ec.company_name, es.station_name, es.installed_capacity FROM energy.energy_company ec JOIN energy.energy_station es ON ec.company_id = es.company_id WHERE (ec.company_id, es.installed_capacity) IN (SELECT company_id, MAX(installed_capacity) FROM energy.energy_station GROUP BY company_id);

question: 请帮我查询应付金额最高的20个订单。

knowledge.text: 高价值用户（核心用户/高消费用户/大客户）通常按用户累计应付金额或累计支付金额排序。SQL逻辑：ORDER BY SUM(ecommerce.orders.payable_amount) DESC。示例：SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, ROUND(SUM(o.payable_amount), 2) AS total_payable FROM ecommerce.customer c JOIN ecommerce.orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name ORDER BY total_payable DESC LIMIT 10。

月销售额（按月销售额/每月成交额）按订单时间 order_time 的年月维度汇总订单应付金额。SQL逻辑：GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ecommerce.orders.order_time, '%Y-%m')。示例：SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, ROUND(SUM(payable_amount), 2) AS monthly_sales FROM ecommerce.orders GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(order_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month。

knowledge.text: GMV（商品交易总额/订单总额/交易总额）指订单商品总交易额，通常按订单表 total_amount 汇总，不扣除优惠、退款或支付失败；若题目强调实付金额，应使用 payable_amount 或 payment_amount。SQL逻辑：SUM(ecommerce.orders.total_amount)。示例：SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS gmv FROM ecommerce.orders。注意：如果问题明确要求成交或实付，优先使用 payable_amount。

question: 请帮我查询销量最高的20个商品，返回查询结果。

knowledge.text: 热销商品（TOP商品/畅销商品/销量最高商品）通常按销量从高到低排序；若问题强调销售额，则按 item_amount 汇总排序。SQL逻辑：ORDER BY SUM(ecommerce.order_item.quantity) DESC。示例：SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sales_quantity FROM ecommerce.order_item oi JOIN ecommerce.product p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY sales_quantity DESC LIMIT 10。

类目内商品销售排名（类目排名/分类商品排名）：统计每个商品的销售额或销量后，在商品分类内部排序。MySQL 5.7 可通过自连接或变量实现；若训练 SQL 允许 MySQL 8，可使用窗口函数。SQL模式：RANK within category by SUM(order_item.item_amount) or SUM(order_item.quantity)。示例：SELECT pc.category_name, p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(oi.item_amount) AS sales_amount FROM ecommerce.order_item oi JOIN ecommerce.product p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN common.product_category pc ON p.category_id = pc.category_id GROUP BY pc.category_name, p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY pc.category_name, sales_amount DESC。

similar_cases.question: 1980年至1983年间三分命中率超过60%的NBA全明星球员有哪些？
similar_cases.query: SELECT DISTINCT T2.playerID FROM professional_basketball.player_allstar AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players_teams AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 1983 AND T1.three_attempted > 0 AND CAST(T1.three_made AS REAL) / T1.three_attempted > 0.6 AND T2.lgID = 'NBA'

similar_cases.question: 计算Yelp上周日早9点到晚9点营业的商家占周日所有营业商家的百分比。
similar_cases.query: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.opening_time = '9AM' AND T2.closing_time = '9PM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.day_id) FROM public_review_platform.Days AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Business_Hours AS T2 ON T1.day_id = T2.day_id WHERE T1.day_of_week = 'Sunday'

similar_cases.question: 计算Yelp上周一和周二早10点到晚9点营业的商家数量差。
similar_cases.query: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T3.day_of_week = 'Monday' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T3.day_of_week = 'Tuesday' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DIFF FROM public_review_platform.Business AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Business_Hours AS T2 ON T1.business_id = T2.business_id INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Days AS T3 ON T2.day_id = T3.day_id WHERE T2.opening_time = '10AM' AND T2.closing_time = '9PM'

similar_cases.question: 列出迪士尼票房超过1亿美元的电影的导演姓名。
similar_cases.query: SELECT DISTINCT T2.director FROM disney.characters AS T1 INNER JOIN disney.director AS T2 ON T1.movie_title = T2.name INNER JOIN disney.movies_total_gross AS T3 ON T1.movie_title = T3.movie_title WHERE CAST(REPLACE(trim(T3.total_gross, '$'), ',', '') AS REAL) > 100000000

similar_cases.question: 在男性奥运运动员中，列出身高超过所有男性平均身高87%的人所在区域名称。
similar_cases.query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.region_name FROM olympics.noc_region AS T1 INNER JOIN olympics.person_region AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.region_id INNER JOIN olympics.person AS T3 ON T2.person_id = T3.id WHERE T3.gender = 'M' AND T3.height * 100 > ( SELECT AVG(height) FROM olympics.person WHERE gender = 'M' ) * 87

similar_cases.question: 按姓氏列出所有已故门将，并列出他们上场时间最多的那个赛季。
similar_cases.query: SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName, T2.year, T2.Min FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.deathYear IS NOT NULL AND T2.Min = (SELECT MAX(Min) FROM hockey.Goalies WHERE playerID = T1.playerID)

similar_cases.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oppID), T2.tmID, T2.oppID FROM hockey.Teams AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.TeamVsTeam AS T2 ON T1.year = T2.year AND T1.tmID = T2.tmID WHERE T2.year = 1915 GROUP BY T2.tmID, T2.oppID ORDER BY SUM(T2.W) DESC LIMIT 1
